summary: AIFU Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its extraordinary general meeting held on April 29, 2026. Shareholders approved a capital reduction reducing par value from $0.4 to $0.0001 per share, followed by a series of share consolidations (1-for-20) and authorized capital increases, culminating in authorized capital of $20M divided into 500M ordinary shares at $0.04 par each. These are routine capital restructuring steps, not a special situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist event is involved.
